# Copilot Instructions

## Coding Conventions
The following conventions are used in the project to maintain readability and consistency across
the codebase:

- Follow the rules defined within the [.editorconfig](../.editorconfig) file
- Consider the [Framework design guidelines][3]
- Consider the [C# identifier naming rules and conventions][1]
- Consider the [Common C# code conventions][2]
- Adopt the existing patterns used within the project

Specific conventions for class structuring and unit test structuring are defined in the
instruction files located in the [instructions](instructions) folder.


[1]: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/csharp/fundamentals/coding-style/identifier-names
[2]: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/csharp/fundamentals/coding-style/coding-conventions
[3]: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/standard/design-guidelines/
